name: Temple of the Dawn

intent.interpretation: Use the existing NeoMud cathedral image as concept art and composition reference, then produce a conventional runtime asset package rather than procedural runtime geometry.
intent.target: A readable cathedral interior with a long nave, altar focus, stained glass color, blocked collision around sacred furniture, and a clear north exit back to Town Square.

spatialLayout.playerEntrance: north end of nave facing south toward the altar
spatialLayout.landmark: raised dawn altar on the south end

exitAffordances.visual: large arched doors at the north end

qaAcceptance: GLB validates with the room profile.
Temple runtime loads from the Blender GLB package.
Temple debug landmarks report a blender-level source.
Temple north trigger routes to town:square.
Altar collision remains present as altar-dais.
Chrome Canary offline smoke and fixed room-shot QA pass.
knownLimits: Materials are currently Blender-authored flat/stylized materials rather than the final generated texture family.
The runtime still keeps the old procedural Temple builder as a removal candidate after the GLB path stabilizes.
This pass proves the production pipeline; the next pass should improve authored mesh detail, material IDs, and collision/debug visualization.
